game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the desert nomad must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: In Dune Crest, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about program_ok to power up the desert nomad and open the oasis.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Dune Crest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how program_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dune Crest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
